outcome: Reduction in reelin-secreting neurons in mPFC layer VI
Deterioration in social interactions (manifested as a decrease in play soliciting)
cohort: Fetus-containing uterus horns from ready-to-deliver rats were removed by cesarean section, with some exposed to induced perinatal asphyxia and others serving as vaginal or cesarean controls.
finding: Perinatal asphyxia significantly decreased the number of reelin-secreting neurons and calbindin cell density in the medial prefrontal cortex and deteriorated social interactions in rats.
